y-m-50-04.title: Ọ bụrụ na composite function bụ otu n'otu, functions abụọ ahụ ̀ bụ otu n'otu?
y-m-50-04.topic: Ihe anyị nwere ike ikwu banyere f na g mgbe composite function g∘f bụ otu n'otu
y-m-50-04.goal: Chọta uru nke composite function ozugbo site n'tebụl e nyere iji nwalee nkwupụta Eunsu, ma kọwaa otu akụkụ nke nkwupụta si agbaji site n'ihe atụ megidere ebe akụkụ nke ọzọ na-ejide.
y-m-50-04.material:
E nwere sets X={1, 2}, Y={a, b, c}, Z={p, q, r}. Functions f: X→Y na g: Y→Z bụ dịka ndị a.
f(1)=a, f(2)=b
g(a)=p, g(b)=q, g(c)=p
Composite function g∘f na-ekenye g(f(x)) n'ihe x nke X. Function otu n'otu bụ function ebe ihe abụọ dị iche nke domain na-enweta uru dị iche mgbe niile.
Nkwupụta Eunsu: "Ọ bụrụ na g∘f bụ function otu n'otu, mgbe ahụ ma f ma g bụ functions otu n'otu."
y-m-50-04.thinking.0: Kewaa nkwupụta ahụ n'akụkụ abụọ ma kpee nke ọ bụla ikpe n'iche
y-m-50-04.thinking.2: Kọwaa ihe kpatara maka akụkụ na-ejide
y-m-50-04.prereq.0: 'H1' n'ọrụ a bụ naanị akara ọkwa ihe isi ike n'ikesa mmepụta ma ọ pụtaghị na usoro ọmụmọ na-akụzi ọdịnaya a n'ọkwa pụrụ iche. Ntọala: were na ị maralarị nkọwa nke function, ịchọta uru nke composite function (g∘f)(x)=g(f(x)), na ihe function otu n'otu pụtara (ihe abụọ dị iche nke domain na-ekwekọ mgbe niile n'uru dị iche). Anaghị eji mmekọrịta otu n'otu na inverse functions.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.prompt: Chọta uru nke g∘f ozugbo maka f na g dị n'elu, ma họrọ ihe ihe atụ a na-egosi banyere nkwupụta Eunsu.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.hint.0: Chọta g∘f(1) na g∘f(2) n'iche ma hazie ha n'tebụl.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee ma ọ bụla n'uru atọ g(a), g(b), g(c) nke g hà ibe ha.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụrụ na g∘f bụ otu n'otu, mgbe ahụ g ga-abụkwa otu n'otu
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.a: Tụnyere g(a) na g(c). Lelee ma g a nwere ikpe ebe ihe abụọ dị iche nwere otu uru.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.b: N'ihe atụ a, g∘f abụghị function otu n'otu
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.b: Gbakọọ g(f(1)) na g(f(2)) ozugbo ma lelee ma ha hà nhata. Lelee ma ị kpebiri tupu ịgbakọ.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.c: Ọbụlagodi ma g∘f bụ otu n'otu, g nwere ike ọ gaghị abụ otu n'otu
y-m-50-04.s.s1.o.d: c anaghị apụta n'etiti uru nke f, ya mere ọ dịghị mkpa ichee g(c) n'ihe atụ a
y-m-50-04.s.s1.r.d: Ịbụ g otu n'otu ga-enyocha n'ihe ọ bụla nke domain Y nke g. Lelee kwa uru g na-ewere na c, nke anaghị apụta n'etiti uru nke f.
y-m-50-04.s.s1.explain: g∘f(1)=g(a)=p na g∘f(2)=g(b)=q, ya mere g∘f bụ otu n'otu. Ma g(a)=g(c)=p, ya mere g abụghị otu n'otu. Ya mere akụkụ nkwupụta na-ekwu 'g kwa' na-agbaji site n'otu ihe atụ a. Otu ihe atụ megidere nwere ike imebi 'mgbe niile'.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.prompt: Oge a, ka anyị wuo ihe atụ megidere ozugbo site n'ọnụọgụ. X={1, 2}, Y={1, 2, 3}, Z={1, 2, 3}, na f(1)=1, f(2)=2. Kpebie uru g(1)=u, g(2)=v, g(3)=w (nke ọ bụla otu n'1, 2, 3), ma mee (u, v, w) atọ dị iche nke g∘f bụ otu n'otu ma g abụghị otu n'otu.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee dịka nkwupụta ihe g(f(1)) na g(f(2)) kwesịrị ịdị ka ka g∘f bụrụ otu n'otu.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ka g ghara ịbụ otu n'otu, lelee ihe ga-eme n'etiti uru atọ u, v, w, ma lelee n'iche ma g(3) nọ n'etiti uru nke g∘f.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Uru atọ niile bụ ihe nke Z.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Uru nke g ga-abụ ihe nke Z={1, 2, 3} (otu n'1, 2, 3).
y-m-50-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Tụnyere g∘f(1)=g(f(1))=u na g∘f(2)=g(f(2))=v. N'ikpe a g∘f abụghị otu n'otu.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.fail.c3: u, v, w niile dị iche. Mgbe ahụ g bụ ọrụ one-to-one nke na-enye ụkpụrụ dị iche maka ntinye atọ dị iche.
y-m-50-04.s.s2.explain: Ụkpụrụ nke g∘f bụ naanị u na v, ya mere ọ bụrụ na u≠v, g∘f bụ one-to-one. Ka g ghara ịbụ one-to-one, g(3)=w ga-ahà nhata u ma ọ bụ v. Ọbụna ma g na-emegharị ụkpụrụ gara aga na 3, nke na-apụtaghị n'etiti ụkpụrụ f, ọ nweghị mmetụta na g∘f. Ọ bụrụ na w dị iche na u na v, g na-aghọkwa one-to-one, ya mere ọ pụghị ịbụ ihe atụ megidere.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.prompt: Akụkụ nke nkwupụta Eunsu nke na-ekwu "ọ bụrụ na g∘f bụ one-to-one, mgbe ahụ f bụ one-to-one" ziri ezi. Kọwaa ihe mere o ji ziri ezi.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tụgharịa uche otu ihe atụ ebe f abụghị one-to-one (f(1)=f(2)) ma dee ụkpụrụ abụọ nke g∘f.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.hint.1: Lelee site n'nkọwa nke ọrụ ihe g na-enye mgbe a tinye otu ụkpụrụ ahụ n'ime g.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.placeholder: dịka, Ọ bụrụ na f abụghị one-to-one, ...
y-m-50-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mgbe ị 'weere na f abụghị one-to-one', ị kwuru ntinye abụọ kpọmkwem na otu ụkpụrụ ahụ?
y-m-50-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ọ̀ gụnyere isi okwu na itinye ụkpụrụ ahụ n'ime g na-enye otu ụkpụrụ pụta?
y-m-50-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị chekwara 'ihe mere otu usoro ahụ anaghị arụ ọrụ maka g'?
y-m-50-04.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na f abụghị one-to-one, ya mere ntinye abụọ dị iche nwere otu ụkpụrụ dị ka f(1)=f(2), mgbe ahụ itinye ha n'ime g na-enyekwa g(f(1))=g(f(2)), otu ahụ. Mgbe ahụ g∘f abụghị one-to-one. Ya mere ọ bụrụ na g∘f bụ one-to-one, f ga-abụrịrị one-to-one.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.model.1: A na-ekpebi ụkpụrụ nke g∘f site n'itinye ụkpụrụ nke f n'ime g. Ọ bụrụ na f na-enye otu ụkpụrụ ugboro abụọ, g na-enye otu azịza maka ụkpụrụ ahụ, ya mere na g∘f ntinye dị iche na-enyekwa otu mmepụta. Mgbe ahụ ọ pụghị ịbụ one-to-one.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ọ kọwara n'okwu n'enweghị mgbaàmà, mana ọ nwere abụọ echiche nke otu ụkpụrụ na nkwubi okwu.
y-m-50-04.s.s3.model.2: Otu ntinye na-enye naanị otu ụkpụrụ, ya mere g enweghị ike ịkewa ọzọ ụkpụrụ abụọ f jikọtara. Ya mere g∘f enweghị ike ịbụ one-to-one kwa.

y-m-50-03.title: Ịkwaga mgbe ahụ ịtụgharị megidere ịtụgharị mgbe ahụ ịkwaga: nsonaazụ ọ̀ bụ otu?
y-m-50-03.topic: Usoro ịkwaga eserese na ịtụgharị ya n'x-axis (ọnọdụ ka nsonaazụ bụrụ otu)
y-m-50-03.goal: Kwenye site n'ihe atụ megidere na eserese nsonaazụ nwere ike ịdị iche dabere n'usoro ịkwaga na ịtụgharị n'x-axis, chọta n'onwe gị ikpe ebe ịgbanwe usoro na-enye otu eserese, ma kọwaa ihe mere site n'ọnọdụ vertex.
y-m-50-03.material:
Ka anyị gbanwee eserese y=x² n'usoro abụọ.
Usoro A: Buru ụzọ tụgharịa ya n'x-axis, mgbe ahụ kwaga ya site na p n'ntụziaka x na q n'ntụziaka y.
Usoro B: Buru ụzọ kwaga ya site na p n'ntụziaka x na q n'ntụziaka y, mgbe ahụ tụgharịa ya n'x-axis.
(Positive p pụtara ịkwaga n'aka nri ma negative p n'aka ekpe, positive q pụtakwara elu ma negative q ala. Ịtụgharị n'x-axis pụtara ịgbagharị ya elu ala.)
Minho na-ekwu, "Ọbụlagodi ma ị gbanwee usoro, eserese nsonaazụ bụ otu mgbe niile."

y-m-50-03.thinking.1: Chọta ihe atụ megidere na ọnọdụ ka ọ na-ejide
y-m-50-03.thinking.2: Kọwaa ihe kpatara site n'ọnọdụ vertex
y-m-50-03.prereq.0: 'H1' n'ọrụ a bụ naanị akara ọkwa ihe isi ike n'ikesa mmepụta ma ọ pụtaghị na usoro ọmụmọ na-akụzi ọdịnaya a n'ọkwa pụrụ iche. Ntọala: were na ị maralarị eserese y=x² (parabola na-emeghe n'elu nwere vertex ya n'origin), mkpọpụ nke na-akwaga ebe (x, y) site na p n'ntụziaka x na q n'ntụziaka y, na ntụgharị n'x-axis nke na-akwaga ebe (x, y) gaa (x, -y).
y-m-50-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ uru nnwale (p, q) niile nwere ike igosi na nkwupụta Minho na-ezighị ezi. (Ikpe ebe eserese nsonaazụ nke A na B dị iche n'ibe ha)
y-m-50-03.s.s1.hint.0: Họrọ otu uru nnwale ma dee coordinates vertex nke A na B n'iche.
y-m-50-03.s.s1.hint.1: Jiri eziokwu na ọ bụrụ na coordinates nke vertices abụọ dị iche, eserese dịkwa iche.
y-m-50-03.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe p abụghị 0 ma q bụ 0, dee ebe vertices nke A na B na-eru. Lelee ma vertices bụ otu n'ụzọ abụọ ahụ.
y-m-50-03.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ọ nweghị ihe e kwagara, ụzọ abụọ ahụ na-enye eserese y=x² e tụgharịrị n'x-axis. Na uru a ị pụghị ịhụ ọdịiche dị n'etiti usoro abụọ ahụ.
y-m-50-03.s.s1.r.e: Ọ bụrụ na ị kwaga naanị n'akụkụ, ịgbanwe usoro na ntụgharị x-axis anaghị eme ọdịiche. Chọta vertices nke ụzọ abụọ ahụ n'iche.
y-m-50-03.s.s1.explain: A nwere vertex ya na (p, q) ma na-emeghe n'ala, B nwekwara vertex ya na (p, -q) ma na-emeghe n'ala. Ọ bụrụ na q abụghị 0, y-coordinates nke vertices dị iche, ya mere ha bụ eserese dị iche. Ọ bụrụ na q bụ 0, ha bụ otu n'agbanyeghị p.
y-m-50-03.s.s2.prompt: Oge a, n'ụzọ megidere, mee ụzọ 3 (p, q), nwere p dị iche, nke nsonaazụ bụ otu ọbụlagodi ma e gbanwee usoro. p na q bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na -9 ruo 9.
y-m-50-03.s.s2.hint.0: Chetakwa ikpe n'nzọụkwụ gara aga ebe, site n'uru nnwale ole na ole, vertices nke A na B ghọrọ otu.
y-m-50-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nwalee nke n'p na q na-eme ọdịiche n'etiti vertices nke A na B.
y-m-50-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Biko debe p na q dịka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na -9 ruo 9.
y-m-50-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Vertices nke A na B na-aghọ otu.
y-m-50-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Vertices nke A na B dị iche. Tụnyere y-coordinates nke vertices nke ụzọ abụọ ahụ.
y-m-50-03.s.s2.explain: Nsonaazụ nke A bụ y=-(x-p)²+q nsonaazụ nke B bụkwa y=-(x-p)²-q. Ka nkwupụta abụọ ahụ bụrụ otu, anyị chọrọ q=-q, ya bụ, q=0, p nwekwara ike ịbụ uru ọ bụla.
y-m-50-03.s.s3.prompt: Kọwaara Minho, site n'iji ọnọdụ vertex, ihe mere p nwere ike ịbụ uru ọ bụla ma q ga-abụ 0 ka nsonaazụ bụrụ otu mgbe e gbanwere usoro.
y-m-50-03.s.s3.hint.0: Soro ma dee ọnọdụ vertex nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ n'A na n'B.
y-m-50-03.s.s3.hint.1: Chee ntụpọ coordinate kedu nke ebe ntụgharị n'x-axis na-emetụta.
y-m-50-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ dere coordinates vertex nke A na B nke ọma, dịka (p, q) na (p, -q)?
y-m-50-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru ihe mere mmegharị p n'ntụziaka x enweghị mmekọrịta na ntụgharị x-axis?
y-m-50-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kwuru ihe mere ọnọdụ elu-ala ji agbanwe dabere n'usoro maka mmegharị q n'ntụziaka y?
y-m-50-03.s.s3.model.0: N'B, anyị na-ebu ụzọ kwaga vertex na (p, q) mgbe ahụ tụgharịa, ya mere ihe ịrịba ama nke y-coordinate nke vertex na-agbanwe ma ọ na-aghọ (p, -q). N'A, anyị na-akwaga mgbe ntụgharị, ya mere vertex bụ (p, q). Ka q na -q hà nhata, q ga-abụ 0, mmegharị p n'ntụziaka x enweghịkwa mmekọrịta na ntụgharị x-axis, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịbụ uru ọ bụla.
y-m-50-03.s.s3.model.1: Ntụgharị n'x-axis na-agbagharị ihe elu ala. Ọ bụrụ na ị welie ya site na q mgbe ahụ tụgharịa ya, ọ na-aga ala site na q, ma ọ bụrụ na ị tụgharịa ya mgbe ahụ welie ya, ọ na-anọgide n'elu. Ya mere ọ bụrụ na q abụghị 0, ịdị elu nke vertex dị iche, ịkwaga n'akụkụ enweghị mmetụta.
y-m-50-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: O kọwara n'okwu kama akara, ma o jiri ịdị elu nke vertex dịka ihe kpatara.

y-m-50-01.title: Iwu e doziri site n'nkwupụta abụọ: uru ole dị n'oke?
y-m-50-01.topic: Ọnọdụ ka nha e doziri site n'nkwupụta n'oge e kewara bụrụ function (uru n'ebe oke)
y-m-50-01.goal: Mara na ka nha e doziri site n'nkwupụta dị iche n'oge ọ bụla bụrụ function, a ga-edozi uru ahụ ruo otu n'ebe oke, mee ọtụtụ nkwupụta na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma kwuo na ọnọdụ ahụ bụ otu mmekọrịta.
y-m-50-01.material: Seoa mere iwu nha n'real numbers niile. (Ọ bụrụ na x bụ 2 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị, y bụ x+3.) (Ọ bụrụ na x bụ 2 ma ọ bụ karịa, y bụ a okpukpu x gbakwunyere b, ya bụ, y=ax+b.) Ebe a a na b bụ constants a kpebibeghị ka. Seoa na-ekwu, "Edere m nkwupụta n'akụkụ abụọ, ya mere nke a bụ function." Otu esi agụ: 'x≤2' pụtara 'x bụ 2 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị' ma 'x≥2' pụtara 'x bụ 2 ma ọ bụ karịa'. Mgbe x bụ kpọmkwem 2, ahịrị abụọ ahụ na-emetụta.

Ntọala: nkọwa nke function (x ọ bụla n'domain na-ekwekọ kpọmkwem otu y) na itinye uru x n'linear expression y=ax+b iji chọta uru y (ọkwa sekọndrị ala). Domain bụ real numbers niile.

y-m-50-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyochaa ma ahịrị abụọ ahụ na-emetụta mgbe x=2, na ahịrị ole na-emetụta mgbe x=0 ma ọ bụ x=5.
y-m-50-01.s.s1.hint.1: Buru ụzọ chọta uru mgbe a tinyere x=2 n'y=x+3, mgbe ahụ mepụta ọnọdụ ebe uru nkwupụta nke abụọ dị iche n'otu x.
y-m-50-01.s.s1.o.a: Slopes nke nkwupụta abụọ ahụ ga-ahàrị nhata
y-m-50-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụlagodi ma slopes hà nhata, ọ bụrụ na ahịrị abụọ ahụ kwagara elu na ala site n'ibe ha, e nwere uru y abụọ na x=2. Tụnyere uru na x=2 maka y=x+3 na y=x+4.
y-m-50-01.s.s1.o.b: Uru y site n'itinye x=2 n'nkwupụta abụọ ahụ ga-ahàrị nhata
y-m-50-01.s.s1.o.c: a na b abụọ ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu
y-m-50-01.s.s1.r.c: Ma a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu enweghị mmekọrịta na ịbụ function. Lelee ma ị nwere ike ime ka uru na x=2 kwekọọ ọbụlagodi n'ọnụọgụ na-abụghị zuru ezu dịka a=1.5.

y-m-50-06.title: Ọ bụrụ na anyị welie ahịrị, ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezute ọ̀ ga-aga n'ihu na-abawanye?
y-m-50-06.topic: Ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezute nke eserese nke ọrụ irrational y=√(x-1)+2 na ahịrị y=x+k (otu o si agbanwe na k)
y-m-50-06.goal: Nwalee site n'ụkpụrụ kpọmkwem ihe mmetụta nke na ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezute na-agbanwe n'ụzọ kwụsiri ike ka ahịrị na-aga n'otu ntụziaka, chọta ọtụtụ ụkpụrụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma kọwaa na ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezute dabere n'oke nke k.
y-m-50-06.material:
Eserese nke ọrụ f(x)=√(x-1)+2 (x≥1) bụ akụkụ nke na-amalite na isi ntụ (1, 2) ma na-ebili nwayọ n'aka nri. (A na-agụ √ dị ka 'square root', ma √(x-1) bụ 'square root nke x mwepụ 1'.) Ihe atụ ụkpụrụ: f(1)=2, f(2)=3, f(5)=4, f(10)=5.
Anyị na-akwaga ahịrị y=x+k (mkpọda 1, k bụ ihe na-agbanweghị) n'elu na n'ala. Seohyun na-ekwu, "Ọ bụrụ na k na-abawanye, ahịrị na-aga elu, ya mere ọnụọgụ isi ntụ ebe ọ na-ezute eserese na-aga n'ihu na-abawanye."
y-m-50-06.prereq.0: 'H1' n'ọrụ a bụ naanị akara ogo isi ike n'nkenye mmepụta ma ọ pụtaghị na usoro ọmụmụ na-akụzi ọdịnaya a n'otu ọkwa. Ntọala: were na ị maralarị na eserese nke ọrụ irrational y=√(x-p)+q na-amalite na isi ntụ (p, q) ma na-agbagọ elu n'aka nri, na ihe dị n'ime square root ga-abụ 0 ma ọ bụ karịa, ọnụọgụ mgbọrọgwụ nke quadratic equation na discriminant, na ilele ebe eserese na-ezute dị ka ngwọta nke ntụnyere a na-edozi ọnụ.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.prompt: Nyochaa ọnụọgụ isi ntụ ebe ahịrị y=x+k na-ezute eserese maka k=0, 1, 2. Họrọ ihe ị nwere ike ịmụta gbasara okwu Seohyun site na nsonaazụ.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.hint.0: Mee tebụl na-atụnyere ụkpụrụ f(x) na x+k na x=1, 2, 5, 10 maka k=0, 1, 2.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.hint.1: N'tebụl, chọta ebe ntụnyere na-agbanwe n'etiti oge ebe f(x) buru ibu karịa ahịrị na oge ebe ọ dị ntakịrị.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.o.a: Maka k=0, 1, 2, ebe ha na-ezute bụ 1, 1, 1, ya mere ọ naghị agbanwe
y-m-50-06.s.s1.r.a: Maka k=1, gbakọọ f(x) na x+1 na x=1 na x=2 ma tụnyere ha. Gụọ ole x na-enye otu ụkpụrụ.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.o.b: Maka k=0, 1, 2, ebe ha na-ezute bụ 1, 2, 0, ya mere ha na-abawanye mgbe ahụ na-ebelata
y-m-50-06.s.s1.o.c: Maka k=0, 1, 2, ebe ha na-ezute bụ 1, 2, 3, ya mere ha na-abawanye otu otu oge ọ bụla
y-m-50-06.s.s1.r.c: Maka k=2, tụnyere ụkpụrụ ka ị lee ma ahịrị nọ n'elu ma ọ bụ n'okpuru eserese na x=1, 2, 5, 10. Lelee ma enwere ebe ha na-ezute.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.o.d: Maka k=0, 1, 2, ebe ha na-ezute bụ 2, 1, 0, ya mere ha na-ebelata naanị
y-m-50-06.s.s1.r.d: Tụnyere k=0 na k=1. Lelee otu ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezute si dị iche n'etiti ụkpụrụ abụọ ahụ.
y-m-50-06.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na k=0, ahịrị y=x nwere f(2)=3>2 na f(5)=4<5, ya mere ọ na-ezute eserese n'otu isi ntụ n'etiti x=2 na 5 (otu isi ntụ). Ọ bụrụ na k=1, mgbe ahụ f(1)=2=1+1 na f(2)=3=2+1, ya mere ha na-ezute na x=1 na x=2 (isi ntụ abụọ). Ọ bụrụ na k=2, ahịrị dị n'elu eserese mgbe niile ma ha anaghị ezute (isi ntụ 0). Ya mere nkwupụta 'na-aga n'ihu na-abawanye' ka ihe atụ megidere gbajiri.
y-m-50-06.s.s2.prompt: Chọta ụkpụrụ k atọ dị iche nke enwere kpọmkwem ebe ha na-ezute abụọ. Ị nwere ike ide decimal. (dịka, 1.1)
y-m-50-06.s.s2.hint.0: Mee tebụl, na-abawanye k obere obere, ka ị lee ma ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezute na-agbanwe n'ebe ụfọdụ n'etiti k=1 na k=2.
y-m-50-06.s.s2.hint.1: Mee otu tebụl ahụ maka ụkpụrụ k dị ala karịa 1 (0, 0.5, 0.9) ma tụnyere ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezute.
y-m-50-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Ahịrị na-agafe n'isi ntụ mmalite (1, 2) ma ọ bụ n'elu ya.
y-m-50-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Maka k a, ahịrị na-agafe n'okpuru isi ntụ mmalite (1, 2) ma enwere naanị otu ebe ha na-ezute.
y-m-50-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Ahịrị dị ala ezuola iji zute eserese ugboro abụọ.
y-m-50-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Maka k a, ahịrị dị elu ezughị ka enwee ebe ha na-ezute abụọ. (Enwere otu ma ọ bụ ọ nweghị.)
y-m-50-06.s.s2.explain: Ịtọ √(x-1)=t (t≥0), anyị na-enweta t+2=t²+1+k, ya bụ, t²-t+k-1=0. Ka enwee ebe ha na-ezute abụọ dị iche, anyị chọrọ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ dị iche na-adịghị mma. Discriminant bụ 5-4k>0 ma ngwaahịa nke mgbọrọgwụ abụọ bụ k-1≥0, ya mere 1≤k<5/4. Ọ bụrụ na k=5/4 ha na-emetụ n'otu isi ntụ, ọ bụrụ na k<1 enwere otu isi ntụ, ma ọ bụrụ na k>5/4 ha anaghị ezute.
y-m-50-06.s.s3.prompt: Kọwaara Seohyun ihe ị mụtara gbasara otu ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezute si agbanwe site na k. Nye ihe atụ ọnụọgụ, ma ọ bụrụ na ị chọtaghị oke kpọmkwem, ị nwere ike ide nchoputa gbasara n'etiti ụkpụrụ ndị ọ dị.
y-m-50-06.s.s3.hint.0: Depụta, otu n'ahịrị, ụkpụrụ k na ọnụọgụ ebe ha na-ezute ị kwenyesiri ike n'nzọụkwụ abụọ gara aga.
y-m-50-06.s.s3.hint.1: Na-elegara ihe ị depụtara anya, dee n'otu ahịrịokwu usoro ọnụọgụ na-agbanwe.

Ọ bụrụ na k dị ala karịa 1, enwere otu isi ntụ; ọ bụrụ na k bụ site na 1 ruo ala karịa 1.25, isi ntụ abụọ; ọ bụrụ na ọ karịrị nke ahụ, ha anaghị ezute (na 1.25 ha na-emetụ n'otu isi ntụ). Mgbe ị na-ewelite ahịrị, na mbụ ọ na-ezute eserese otu ugboro, mgbe ahụ ugboro abụọ, na mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị ọ naghị ezute ma ọlị.
y-m-50-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Azịza nke chọtara oke kpọmkwem. Ọbụna ma achọtaghị ya, a na-anabata nkọwa nwere ihe atụ ọnụọgụ.

y-m-50-02.title: Anyị nwere ike ịmata ihe ịrịba ama nke b site n'nkọwa nke eserese naanị?
y-m-50-02.topic: Ikpebi ihe ịrịba ama nke coefficients site n'nkọwa nke eserese nke quadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (ịdị zuru ezu nke ozi)
y-m-50-02.goal: Kpee ikpe nchikota kedu n'etiti ọtụtụ ozi na-akọwa eserese n'okwu zuru ezu iji kpebie ihe ịrịba ama nke coefficients, ma wuo functions dị iche na-emezu nkọwa niile iji kwenye na nkọwa naanị anaghị edozi function ruo otu.
y-m-50-02.material:
Jimin kọwara eserese nke quadratic function y=ax²+bx+c (a, b, c bụ real numbers, a≠0) n'okwu. E nweghị ihe osise. A na-agụ nkwupụta dịka 'y hà a okpukpu x squared gbakwunyere b okpukpu x gbakwunyere c'.
(가) Eserese na-emeghe n'elu (ọ bụ convex n'ala).
(나) Y-coordinate nke ebe ọ na-ezute y-axis bụ 3.
(다) Vertex dị n'aka nri nke y-axis. (X-coordinate nke vertex bụ positive.)
(라) Ọ na-ezute x-axis n'ebe abụọ dị iche.
y-m-50-02.thinking.0: Kpee ikpe ịdị zuru ezu nke ozi
y-m-50-02.thinking.1: Chee mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ọnọdụ vertex na ihe ịrịba ama nke coefficients
y-m-50-02.prereq.0: 'H1' n'ọrụ a bụ naanị akara ọkwa ihe isi ike n'ikesa mmepụta ma ọ pụtaghị na usoro ọmụmọ na-akụzi ọdịnaya a n'ọkwa pụrụ iche. Ntọala: were na ị maralarị na eserese nke quadratic function y=ax²+bx+c bụ parabola, na ihe ịrịba ama nke a na-ekpebi ntụziaka mmeghe, na x-coordinate nke vertex bụ -b/(2a) (ma ọ bụ otu esi agbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ udi y=a(x-p)²+q), na mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ọnụọgụ ebe ọ na-ezute x-axis na ihe ịrịba ama nke discriminant b²-4ac.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.prompt: Anyị chọrọ ikpebi ihe ịrịba ama nke b (positive ma ọ bụ negative). Kedu nkọwa n'etiti (가) ruo (라) ka anyị ga-amarịrị ọnụ iji kpebie ya site n'ozi kacha nta?
y-m-50-02.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee nkwupụta maka x-coordinate nke vertex site n'iji a na b.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.hint.1: Depụta nchikota niile nke ihe ịrịba ama nke (a, b) na-eme ka nkwupụta ahụ bụrụ positive.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.r.b: Vertex ịdị n'aka nri pụtara -b/(2a) bụ positive, nke na-agwa anyị naanị na a na b nwere ihe ịrịba ama megidere. Rụọ ọrụ ihe b bụ mgbe a bụ positive na mgbe a bụ negative.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.r.c: (나) na (라) bụ banyere uru c na discriminant, ya mere ha anaghị agwa ihe ịrịba ama nke a. Nwalee ma y=-x²+2x+3 nwere a negative (c=3, discriminant 16, x-coordinate nke vertex 1) na-emezu nkọwa atọ ndị a.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.r.d: (가) na-agwa ihe ịrịba ama nke a (나) na-agwakwa uru c. N'enweghị ọnọdụ aka ekpe-aka nri nke vertex, gbanwee b n'otu a na c ma lelee ma ihe ịrịba ama nke b edoziri.
y-m-50-02.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na x-coordinate nke vertex -b/(2a) bụ positive (다) ma a bụ positive (가), mgbe ahụ b bụ negative. Site n'(다) naanị, anyị maara naanị na a na b nwere ihe ịrịba ama megidere. (나) na (라) enweghị mmekọrịta ozugbo na ihe ịrịba ama nke b.
y-m-50-02.s.s2.prompt: Mee quadratic functions atọ nwere b dị iche nke na-emezu (가) ruo (라) niile. (Tinye uru a, b, na c.)
y-m-50-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kpebie c site n'(나), ma kpebie ihe ịrịba ama nke a na b site n'(가) na (다).
y-m-50-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tụọ aro onye a na-atụ anya maka a na b otu otu, ma gbakọọ b²-4ac ozugbo iji lelee (라).

y-m-50-02.s.s3.prompt: Jimin jụrụ, "Site n'nkọwa anọ, anyị nwere ike idozi function a ruo otu, ee?" Zaa dabere n'functions ị mere n'elu, ọ bụrụkwa na enweghị ike idozi ya, dee kwa ihe ọzọ achọrọ.

y-m-50-05.topic: Ozi achọrọ iji kwụsị eserese nke ọrụ rational y=a+k/(x-p) (asymptotes na isi ntụ ọ na-agafe)
y-m-50-05.goal: Kpebie na asymptotes naanị anaghị akwụsị ọrụ rational n'otu, na ịgbakwunye isi ntụ ọ na-agafe na-akwụsị ya, na mgbe enwere ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ ha nwere ike ịgbagha; gbanwee ma ọ bụ debe ikpe gị, ma jiri onwe gị mejupụta ọnọdụ ndị na-agbagha ka ị ga-enyo enyo.
y-m-50-05.material: Ozi gbasara eserese nke otu ọrụ rational na-abata otu otu. Enweghị foto. A na-agụ okwu dị ka 'y hà nhata 3 tinye k n'elu (x mwepụ 2)' otú ahụ. Asymptote bụ ahịrị nke eserese na-abịaru nso na-enweghị njedebe mana ọ naghị ezute.
y-m-50-05.thinking.1: Lelee ma ọnọdụ na-agbagha ibe ha
y-m-50-05.thinking.2: Tụnyere ma tụọ ọnọdụ ị ga-enyo enyo
y-m-50-05.prereq.0: 'H1' n'ọrụ a bụ naanị akara ogo isi ike n'nkenye mmepụta ma ọ pụtaghị na usoro ọmụmụ na-akụzi ọdịnaya a n'otu ọkwa. Ntọala: were na ị maralarị na eserese nke ọrụ rational y=k/(x-p)+q (k≠0) nwere ahịrị abụọ x=p na y=q dị ka asymptotes, na otu esi etinye nhazi nke isi ntụ n'ime okwu ka ọ kwekọọ n'ụkpụrụ.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe ozi otu otu. Oge ọ bụla, kpebie site n'ozi ruo ugbu a, ma mgbe ozi ọhụrụ bịara, kpebie ma debe ma ọ bụ gbanwee ikpe gị.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye ozi ọ bụla n'ime okwu ma gụọ ole ihe amaghị fọdụrụ.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tinye ozi ọhụrụ n'ime okwu achọtara na mbụ ma gbakọọ ozugbo ma ọ kwekọrọ.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Ihe naanị amaara gbasara eserese nke ọrụ rational bụ na vertical asymptote ya bụ ahịrị x=2 ma horizontal asymptote ya bụ ahịrị y=3. Ọrụ a nwere udi y=3+k/(x-2) (k bụ ihe na-agbanweghị na-abụghị efu).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ọ̀ bụ na a kwụsịrị ọrụ n'otu site na ozi a naanị?
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Ma k bụ 2, 5, ma ọ bụ -3, asymptotes bụ otu, x=2 na y=3. Asymptotes na-agwa naanị 'ọkpụkpụ' ebe eserese nọ, ma ha anaghị agwa k (ole eserese na-agbagọ, quadrants ọ bụla ọ dị).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: A kwụsịrị ya. E nyere asymptotes abụọ, ya mere a kwụsịkwara k
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ọbụna ma k bụ 2 ma ọ bụ 5, asymptotes bụ otu, x=2 na y=3. Lelee ma ị nwere ike ịmata ụkpụrụ k site n'ilele asymptotes naanị.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A kwụsịghị ya. Eserese nwere ụkpụrụ k dị iche niile nwere asymptotes ndị a
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: A kwụsịghị ya. A chọrọ otu asymptote ọzọ
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ọrụ rational nke udi a nwere kpọmkwem asymptotes abụọ. Ihe na-efu abụghị ọnụọgụ asymptotes kama ozi ọzọ nke na-akwụsị k.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Ozi ọhụrụ e nyere: eserese a na-agafe isi ntụ (0, 1).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ugbu a, gịnị bụ ụkpụrụ k?
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Itinye x=0, y=1 na-enye 1=3+k/(0-2)=3-k/2, ya mere k=4. A kwụsịrị eserese dị ka y=3+4/(x-2), ya bụ, y=(3x-2)/(x-2).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Mgbe ị na-etinye x=0, y=1 n'ime okwu, lelee na ị tinyere x=0 n'x-2 mgbe ị na-agbakọ. Otu mgbaàmà nwere ike ịdị njọ.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Itinye otu isi ntụ n'ime okwu na-eme otu ntụnyere n'ime k. Chee echiche ma ntụnyere ahụ nwere otu ngwọta.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Ozi ọzọ: eserese a na-agafekwa isi ntụ (4, 6). Mana ọ bụrụ na ị tinye x=4 n'ime y=3+4/(x-2) achọtara na mbụ, ị na-enweta y=5.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kedu ka ị ga-esi were ozi ọhụrụ a?
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ọ bụrụ na ị debe asymptote y=3 dị ka ọ dị, ọ nweghị eserese na-agafe abụọ isi ntụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ horizontal asymptote ka ọ bụrụ y=a, mgbe ahụ a=3.5, k=5 na-enye eserese na-agafe abụọ isi ntụ. Ozi ị ga-atụkwasị obi kwesịrị ikpebi site n'isi mmalite nke ozi na ma enwere ike ilele ya.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Dee ọzọ k dị ka 6 ma chefuo isi ntụ gara aga (0, 1)
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na k=6, mgbe ahụ y=0 na x=0, nke na-emegide isi ntụ (0, 1) e nyere na mbụ. Chee echiche ma enwere ihe kpatara ịtụfu ozi gara aga.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ebe ọnọdụ ndị ahụ (asymptotes abụọ na isi ntụ abụọ) anaghị adị mma n'otu oge, anyị ga-elele ọnọdụ nke ezighị ezi
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ozi gbasara (4, 6) nwere ike ịbụ nke e bufere n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi, ya mere debe k=4 dị ka ọ dị ruo mgbe e kwenyesiri ya ike
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Tụkwasị obi na vertical asymptote x=2 mana chee na horizontal asymptote nwere ike ọ gaghị abụ y=3, ma chọta ya ọzọ
y-m-50-05.s.s1.reflect: Lee usoro ilele ozugbo megidere ozi ọhụrụ, oge ọ bụla ozi bawanyere, ma 'ikpe gara aga ka ziri ezi'. Kwenye kwa na enwere ọtụtụ ihe nwere ike ịbụ ihe kpatara mgbe ozi na-agbagha.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.prompt: Ka anyị chọọ ọrụ rational y=a+k/(x-2) nke na-agafe isi ntụ (0, 1) na isi ntụ (4, 6) abụọ ma nwee vertical asymptote x=2. Oge a, ekwụsịla horizontal asymptote dị ka y=3 ma were a dị ka nke amaghị kwa. Tinye (a, k) nwere ike ịdị.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tinye (0, 1) ka ị dee mmekọrịta n'etiti a na k, ma tinye (4, 6) ka ị dee mmekọrịta ọzọ.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.hint.1: Chee echiche ole (a, k) na-emezu mmekọrịta abụọ ahụ ọnụ.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Ọ bụrụ na k=0, ọ bụghị ọrụ rational. Biko jiri ọnụọgụ na-abụghị efu.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c2: y anaghị aghọ 1 mgbe x=0. Tinye (0, 1) n'ime okwu iji lelee.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c3: y anaghị aghọ 6 mgbe x=4. Tinye (4, 6) n'ime okwu iji lelee.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.explain: Itinye isi ntụ abụọ na-enye a-k/2=1 na a+k/2=6; ịgbakwunye na-enye 2a=7, a=3.5, ma iwepụ na-enye k=5. y=3.5+5/(x-2), nke horizontal asymptote ya bụ y=3.5, na-agafe abụọ isi ntụ. Site n'ọnọdụ ndị a enwere naanị otu ngwọta.

y-m-50-07.title: Ọ bụrụ na mgbidi ogologo, ọ̀ ga-abụ mgbe niile na ọgba ga-adị ukwuu?
y-m-50-07.topic: Oke nke ngalaba na nsogbu kacha elu maka ọrụ quadratic (ma vertex dị n'ime ma ọ bụ n'èzí oge)
y-m-50-07.goal: Kpebie, dabere n'ọnọdụ ngalaba, ma kacha elu nke ọrụ quadratic na-apụta na vertex ma ọ bụ na njedebe oge, gbanwee ma ọ bụ debe ikpe gị mgbe ọnọdụ gbanwere, ma mee tebụl nke kacha elu maka ọnọdụ ọ bụla n'onwe gị.
y-m-50-07.material: Anyị na-ewu ọgba rectangular site n'iji ngwa ihe mgbochi 20 m niile. Otu akụkụ jikọtara na mgbidi kwụ ọtọ, enweghị ngwa mgbochi e ji na akụkụ ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ogologo akụkụ jikọtara na mgbidi (akụkụ parallel na mgbidi) bụ x m ma ogologo akụkụ perpendicular na ya bụ y m, mgbe ahụ x+2y=20, ma akụkụ ala A=xy (㎡, square meters) bụ A=x(20-x)/2. (x ugboro '20 mwepụ x', kewaa site na 2) x karịrị 0 ma dị ala karịa 20. Ogologo x nke akụkụ jikọtara na mgbidi enweghị ike ịgafe ogologo mgbidi.
y-m-50-07.thinking.1: Mata ọdịiche dị n'ọnọdụ ebe kacha elu na-apụta (vertex ma ọ bụ njedebe oge)
y-m-50-07.thinking.2: Hazie nsonaazụ maka ọnọdụ ọ bụla n'tebụl
y-m-50-07.prereq.0: 'H1' n'ọrụ a bụ naanị akara ogo isi ike n'nkenye mmepụta ma ọ pụtaghị na usoro ọmụmụ na-akụzi ọdịnaya a n'otu ọkwa. Ntọala: were na ị maralarị vertex nke ọrụ quadratic na ịchọta kacha elu n'oke e kpachibara (a na-ekpebi site n'udi eserese), na ịtọ okwu site n'ịhapụ ogologo akụkụ ka ọ bụrụ mkpụrụedemede.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.prompt: Oge ọ bụla ozi gbasara ogologo mgbidi gbanwere, kpebie x nke na-eme ọgba kacha ukwuu, ma mgbe ozi ọhụrụ bịara, kpebie ma debe ma ọ bụ gbanwee ikpe gị.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.hint.0: Mee obere tebụl nke ụkpụrụ x na A ma chọta ebe ọ kacha ukwuu.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee ma x na-enye ụkpụrụ kacha ukwuu n'tebụl nọ n'oke x a kwere.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Mgbidi ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu, ya mere enweghị oke na x. (0<x<20)
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: X kedu na-enye akụkụ ala kacha ukwuu?
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.after: A(5)=37.5, A(10)=50, A(15)=37.5. Eserese nke A=x(20-x)/2 bụ parabola na-emeghe n'ala nwere elu ya na x=10, ya mere na x=10 kacha elu bụ 50㎡.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: A(5)=5×15/2=37.5. Gbakọọ otu ụkpụrụ ọzọ ka ị tụnyere ihe na-eme akụkụ ala mgbe e mere x ka ọ karịa 5.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: A(15)=15×5/2=37.5. Gbakọọ ma tụnyere ma ọ dị ntakịrị karịa na 10.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Ị chọpụtara na ogologo mgbidi bụ 8 m. (x bụ 8 ma ọ bụ nke dị ala)
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ugbu a, x kedu na-eme ọgba kacha ukwuu?
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Oke a kwere bụ 0<x≤8, ma elu x=10 nọ n'èzí oke. N'ime oke ahụ, A na-eto ka x na-eto, ya mere kacha elu dị na njedebe x=8, ebe A=8×12/2=48 (㎡).
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: x=10 dị ogologo 2 m karịa mgbidi, ya mere enweghị ike ijikọta ya na mgbidi. Lee otu A si agbanwe n'ime oke x a kwere.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: N'oke ebe x bụ 8 ma ọ bụ nke dị ala, gbakọọ ma A na-eto ma ọ bụ na-ebelata site na x=5 ruo 8.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Ewezugara mgbidi gaa n'ebe ka ogologo, ogologo mgbidi ghọrọ 12 m. (x bụ 12 ma ọ bụ nke dị ala)
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: X kedu na-eme ọgba kacha ukwuu?
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Oke a kwere bụ 0<x≤12, ma elu x=10 nọ n'ime oke. Kacha elu bụ 50㎡ na elu, ma na njedebe mgbidi, x=12, ọ bụ 48㎡, nke dị ntakịrị. Iji mgbidi ruo njedebe abụghị nke kacha mma mgbe niile.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: A(11)=11×9/2=49.5. Tụnyere ya na ụkpụrụ na x=10.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri mgbidi ruo njedebe ya, A(12)=12×8/2=48. Tụnyere ya na ụkpụrụ na x=10.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.reflect: Dabere n'ogologo mgbidi, kacha elu mgbe ụfọdụ pụtara na 'vertex' ma mgbe ụfọdụ na 'njedebe oge'. Lelee azụ ihe ị lelere ọhụrụ mgbe ị gbanwere ikpe gị.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.prompt: Mee tebụl nke akụkụ ala A (㎡) kacha ukwuu ị nwere ike iwu mgbe ogologo mgbidi bụ w m (0<w≤20). Tinye ụzọ abụọ (w, A) 3 nwere akụkụ ala kacha elu dị iche.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ w, dee oke x a kwere, ma chọta ebe A kacha ukwuu n'oke ahụ.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.hint.1: Gbanwee w gaa 4, 8, 12, na ndị ọzọ, ma tụnyere otu x na-enye kacha elu si dị iche.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Biko debe w karịrị 0 ma ọ dịghị karịa 20.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Ọ bụ akụkụ ala kacha ukwuu ị nwere ike iwu site na mgbidi ahụ.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Nke a abụghị akụkụ ala kacha ukwuu ị nwere ike iwu site na w a. Chọọ ọzọ ebe A kacha ukwuu n'ime oke x a kwere.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ na w bụ 10 ma ọ bụ nke dị ala, kacha elu dị na njedebe x a kwere, x=w; ọ bụrụ na w bụ 10 ma ọ bụ karịa, ọ dị na elu x=10. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, w=4 na-enye 32, w=8 na-enye 48, w=10 na-enye 50, ma w=15 na-enye 50 (㎡). W dị iche iche na-enye otu akụkụ ala na-eme mgbe w bụ 10 ma ọ bụ karịa.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.prompt: Kpebie ma nkwupụta "Ka mgbidi na-ogologo, ka ọgba ị nwere ike iwu na-ebu ibu" na-adị mma mgbe niile, ma kọwaa ya site n'iji ọnụọgụ dị n'tebụl ị mere ugbu a dị ka ihe akaebe.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.hint.0: Soro site na mmalite ruo njedebe otu ụkpụrụ A si agbanwe ka w na-eto n'tebụl ị mere ugbu a.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.hint.1: Chọta ụkpụrụ w ebe A kwụsịrị ịba ụba.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.placeholder: dịka, Mgbe mgbidi bụ 8 m, ..., mgbe ọ bụ 15 m, ...

y-m-50-07.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na mgbidi bụ 8 m, nke kacha bụ 48㎡, ọ bụrụkwa 12 m, ọ bụ 50㎡, ọbụlagodi na 15 m ọ bụ otu 50㎡ ahụ. Ruo 10 m, mgbidi ka ogologo na-enye mpaghara buru ibu karịa, ma mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị, ịdị ogologo abaghị uru, ya mere 'mgbe niile' adịghị mma.

y-m-50-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Azịza nyere ọnọdụ vertex dị ka ihe kpatara ya.
